acceptance_contract: HARDEN-DEVLOOP-001: GitHubRestPort._request never sends Authorization to an origin other than the API origin; a cross-origin redirect raises AdapterError
same-origin redirect behaviour, 404 mapping, URLError and timeout behaviour, and the read_json_artifact redirect model are preserved
errors never expose token bytes, the Location URL or Location query data
new offline cross-origin redirect tests fail on the sealed base revision and pass on the result
ruff and mypy clean on changed files

RESOLVE:P1-1 REPAIR: change only GitHubRestPort._request and EXTEND (do not rewrite) tests/unit/test_orchestration_dev_github_port_redirects.py. When urllib rejects a redirect before the handler runs (non-http Location scheme; malformed or invalid bracketed-host Location) raise AdapterError AFTER leaving the except block, so message, __cause__ and __context__ hold no Location URL or query. Keep URLError, timeout and JSON errors unchanged. New tests must fail on aee2026b

RESOLVE:P1-2 DETACH: nothing reachable from the raised AdapterError via __cause__ or __context__ may hold a Location URL or query in any attribute (headers, url, filename, fp). If an HTTPError has a Location header or its url is not the request URL, raise AdapterError with the same '-> <status>' message AFTER leaving the except block, no cause/context: redirect loop limit, POST 307/308, same-origin redirect then 4xx/5xx. Other HTTPErrors keep 'from exc'. Tests walk the chain and fail on aee2026b
expected_outputs: dedicated atlas/agent-* branch with exact HEAD/TREE
